combobox.placeholder: Search name, Area, or entity ID…

sys_overview.discovered_banner_one: 1 unbound Latter Device detected on your network ({names}).
sys_overview.discovered_banner_many: {count} unbound Latter Devices detected on your network ({names}).
sys_overview.area_deployment_subtitle: Live occupancy, assigned Devices, and Bluetooth coverage across your Areas.
sys_overview.empty_deployment: No Home Assistant Areas or managed Devices configured yet.
sys_overview.unconfigured_areas_one: +1 additional Home Assistant Area without Latter Devices or BLE coverage.
sys_overview.unconfigured_areas_many: +{count} additional Home Assistant Areas without Latter Devices or BLE coverage.
sys_overview.capabilities_subtitle: Shared entities, media routing, Device groups, colors & wallpapers, and security policies.
sys_overview.cameras_calendars_empty: Connect cameras for doorbell popups and calendars for the Home agenda.
sys_overview.remotes_empty: Add TV, streaming, or AV receiver remotes and volume overrides.
sys_overview.groups_meta_empty: Shared baselines that keep assigned Devices aligned.
sys_overview.pin_active_meta: Default PIN active for opening locks, garage covers, and code-less alarms.
sys_overview.pin_unset_meta: Set a fallback System security PIN for perimeter locks, covers, and alarms.
shared.home_hub_subtitle: Shared climate zones, entry controls, vacuums, security, and weather across every Device.
shared.calendars_subtitle: Upcoming events merged into the Activity card and agenda feed.
shared.wallpapers_subtitle: Shared System wallpapers and presets available to every Latter display.
shared.cameras_subtitle: Up to 10 cameras. Doorbell ring sensors wake displays automatically with listen audio and push-to-talk TTS replies.
shared.doorbell_filter_desc: Noise-reduction preset applied when listening to camera audio.
shared.colors_subtitle: Shared 24-swatch accent library available across all Devices.
remotes.controls_subtitle: Up to 10 TV, streamer, or receiver entities controlled from the Remote screen.
remotes.choose_remote: — Choose a remote or media player —
remotes.overrides_subtitle: Redirects volume buttons when audio plays through an external AVR or soundbar.
remotes.groups_subtitle: Bind sets of remotes to Home Assistant Areas or specific Devices.
groups.title: Device groups
groups.card_subtitle: Built-in hardware presets and custom Device groups that keep assigned Devices aligned.
groups.custom_summary_desc: Devices move to Custom automatically when individual settings diverge from a group baseline.
groups.detached_many_toast: Applied changes ({count} Devices switched to Custom)
groups.dock_baseline_desc_one: Baseline holds 1 shortcut (captures from source Device below).
groups.dock_baseline_desc_many: Baseline holds {count} shortcuts (captures from source Device below).
groups.pinned_baseline_desc_one: Baseline holds 1 shortcut (captures from source Device below).
groups.pinned_baseline_desc_many: Baseline holds {count} shortcuts (captures from source Device below).
groups.clocks_baseline_desc_one: Baseline holds 1 zone (captures from source Device below).
groups.clocks_baseline_desc_many: Baseline holds {count} zones (captures from source Device below).
groups.source_device_desc: Replaces this group's active baseline scope with an existing Device's settings.
groups.confirm_copy_body: Updates the "{group}" baseline from "{device}" and syncs all assigned Devices.
groups.confirm_copy_list_body: Copies {listLabel} from "{device}" into the "{group}" baseline and syncs assigned Devices.
groups.include_display_desc: Sync wallpapers, clock face, color profile, and media appearance.
groups.include_interface_desc: Sync start screen, App Dock, pinned shortcuts, and hub categories.
batch.title: Batch controls
batch.subtitle: Stage changes across a filtered set of Devices, then apply them together without altering saved group baselines.
batch.mixed_hint: Target Devices currently have different values — choose a value to stage across all targets.
batch.detachment_note_one: 1 grouped Device will switch to Custom if staged settings diverge from its group baseline.
batch.detachment_note_many: {count} grouped Devices will switch to Custom if staged settings diverge from their group baselines.
batch.no_targets: No Devices match the selected filter.
batch.empty_category: No batch controls match this category.
batch.template_device_aria: Template Device for batch list copy
batch.template_device_desc: Copies App Dock, pinned shortcuts, or world clocks to {target}.
batch.confirm_push_list_body: Replaces {listLabel} on matching Devices using "{device}" as the template.
presence_sys.area_card_subtitle: Configures how each Area combines Bluetooth tracking and occupancy sensors.
presence_sys.calibrate_hint: calibrate with a carried Device to detect BLE presence here
presence_sys.occupied_at_weighted_desc: The Area counts as occupied when the combined BLE and sensor score reaches this level.
presence_sys.sensors_all_desc: None selected: every sensor in this Area counts.
presence_sys.no_area_sensors: This Area has no occupancy, motion, or door sensors.
presence_sys.empty_areas: No Home Assistant Areas, Bluetooth proxies, or occupancy sensors found yet.
presence_sys.calibration_subtitle: Carry a tracked Device into an Area to check Bluetooth proxy signal levels or save an Area signature.
presence_sys.empty_ble_devices: No Devices currently have Bluetooth Area tracking enabled. Turn on BLE Area tracking on a portable Device, or adopt a phone or tag under Discovered devices.
presence_sys.handoff_ready: Ready to calibrate {area} — carry {device} into {area} and select Calibrate Area.
presence_sys.carried_device_desc: Choose the actively tracked Device or BLE tag you are holding.
presence_sys.live_signal_active: Live BLE signal active — currently detected in
presence_sys.no_recent_packets_prefix: No live BLE packets in the last 12 seconds — wake
presence_sys.no_recent_packets_suffix: or hold it in hand so its Bluetooth beacon broadcasts before calibrating.
presence_sys.cal_desc_no_areas: Create at least one Home Assistant Area before saving a Bluetooth signature.
presence_sys.cal_desc_replace: Updates the saved {count}-proxy Bluetooth signature for {area} using live signal readings.
presence_sys.cal_desc_proxyless: Saves readings from nearby Bluetooth proxies so {area} can detect presence even without its own proxy.
presence_sys.cal_desc_new: Saves Bluetooth signal strengths from nearby proxies while you stand in {area} for more accurate Area boundaries.
presence_sys.antenna_trim_help: Raw {raw} • Offset {offset} — adjust only if this proxy consistently reads stronger or weaker across every Area.
presence_sys.empty_survey: No Bluetooth proxy readings yet for this Device.
presence_sys.advanced_subtitle: System-wide away timeout, maximum detection distance, movement smoothing, and wall signal drop-off.
presence_sys.away_timeout_desc: Seconds without any Bluetooth packet before a tracked tag or offline Device is marked Away.
presence_sys.max_radius_desc: Ignores Bluetooth proxies farther than this distance in meters so outdoor signals do not claim indoor Areas.
presence_sys.max_speed_desc: Smooths sudden signal drops that would imply movement faster than this speed in meters per second.
presence_sys.attenuation_desc: Controls how quickly Bluetooth signal strength fades with distance through walls (default 2.2).
tools_sys.announce_subtitle: Send screen popups or spoken intercom broadcasts to all Devices, occupied Areas, or one display.
tools_sys.doorbell_subtitle: Verify push-to-talk TTS reply playback through Camera 1's bound door speaker.
tools_sys.source_device_desc: Latter Device context used when routing the door speaker reply.
tools_sys.doorbell_desc_no_cam: Add a camera with a bound door speaker in Shared entities first to test TTS reply playback.
tools_sys.doorbell_desc_no_dev: Onboard at least one Latter Device first to route push-to-talk test replies.
tools_sys.doorbell_desc_ready: Plays a short TTS phrase on Camera 1's bound media player ({camera}).
tools_sys.backup_subtitle: Export or restore non-secret System and Device settings as portable JSON bundles.
tools_sys.system_pin_desc: Default 4-to-12-digit PIN required before unlocking doors, opening garage covers, or disarming alarms when a Device requires a PIN.
tools_sys.signing_key_desc: Refreshes the signing key for camera, wallpaper, and doorbell audio links and updates connected Devices.
dialogs.pinned_desc: Assign Home Assistant entity quick actions or deep-link any Latter app or subpage (6 buttons per page, swipable vertically).
dialogs.pinned_empty: No pinned items configured yet. The Pinned icon stays hidden on the App Dock until you add at least one item.
dialogs.home_cats_desc: Toggle and reorder categories shown in the Home hub. The first available category opens by default; categories with no configured entity are not displayed.
dialogs.area_cats_desc: Toggle and reorder categories shown on the Area screen. The first available category opens by default; categories with no entities in the active Area are not displayed.
dialogs.remote_group_desc: Choose which remotes appear on this Device's Remote screen.
dialogs.local_clock_desc: Optional custom label shown above local time on the Clock tab.
dialogs.show_utc_desc: Pin a live 24-hour UTC reference row to this Device's Clock tab.
dialogs.world_clocks_desc: Configure up to 4 custom-labeled time zones (UTC-12:00 to UTC+14:00) shown on this Device's Clock tab.
dialogs.select_tz_placeholder: Select a time zone (UTC-12 to UTC+14)…
dialogs.toast_enter_city: Enter a city or label for this world clock
dialogs.toast_select_tz: Select a time zone for this world clock
dialogs.toast_dup_world_clock: That world clock is already added
dialogs.calendar_lookahead_desc: Number of upcoming days shown on the Overview tab (days with no events are omitted).
dialogs.calendar_week_start_desc: First column shown in Week and Month views.
dialogs.tools_desc: Toggle and reorder utilities shown in the Tools launcher.
dialogs.games_desc: Toggle and reorder games shown in the Games launcher.
dialogs.sc_confirm_dock_desc: Shows a confirmation prompt before running this action from the App Dock.
dialogs.sc_confirm_pinned_desc: Require a confirmation tap instead of running immediately on a single tap.
dialogs.sc_icon_search_placeholder: Search all {total} icons (e.g. teddy-bear, baby, lamp)…
dialogs.sc_icon_no_matches: No matching icons — try another keyword
dialogs.ble_body: A phone, watch, or Bluetooth tag that Latter tracks by Area. Latter displays are adopted under Discovered devices.
dialogs.ble_addr_placeholder: AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF, iBeacon UUID, or tracker entity
dialogs.ble_addr_help: Enter a static BLE MAC address, iBeacon UUID (with optional major:minor), or Home Assistant Companion App or tracker entity.
dialogs.save_group_body: Saves this Device's settings as a reusable Device group and assigns this Device to it.
confirm.remove_device.title: Remove {title}?
confirm.remove_device.body: Removes "{title}" from Latter and deletes its stored Latter preferences and shortcuts. Your ESPHome device stays in Home Assistant.
confirm.reset_device.title: Reset to defaults?
confirm.reset_device.body: Wi-Fi and pairing are kept, so the Device rejoins Home Assistant automatically. Its ESPHome binding and Music Assistant player link are kept too.
confirm.reset_device.device_settings_des: Erases everything saved on the Device and restarts it.
confirm.reset_device.latter_options_desc: Resets shortcuts, group assignment, and Latter preferences for this Device to factory defaults.
confirm.restore_backup.title: Restore from backup?
confirm.restore_backup.body: Overwrites current Latter settings with the selected JSON backup bundle.
confirm.delete_group.title: Delete group "{name}"?
confirm.delete_group.body: Devices currently assigned to this group keep their settings and switch to Custom.
confirm.reset_group.title: Reset "{name}" to preset defaults?
confirm.reset_group.body: Restores the built-in power, wake, and scope defaults for this group and applies them to assigned Devices.
confirm.rotate_signing_key.title: Rotate URL signing key?
confirm.rotate_signing_key.body: Invalidates active signed wallpaper, camera snapshot, and doorbell audio URLs until Devices receive the next state push.
confirm.delete_wallpaper.title: Delete wallpaper "{name}"?
confirm.delete_wallpaper.body: Permanently deletes this uploaded wallpaper. Devices using it revert to their fallback background.
confirm.reset_dock.title: Reset App Dock to default?
confirm.reset_dock.body: Restores the default native apps on the App Dock and removes custom dock shortcuts on this Device.
confirm.clear_ble_signature.title: Clear BLE signature for {area}?
confirm.clear_ble_signature.body: Removes captured RSSI calibration samples for {area} and reverts to path-loss estimation.
confirm.clear_pin.title: Clear security PIN?
confirm.clear_pin.body: Removes the configured security PIN. Perimeter actions governed by Require PIN stay blocked until a new PIN is set.
confirm.apply_batch.title: Apply staged changes to {count} Devices?
confirm.apply_batch.body: Pushes {settingCount} staged setting changes to {count} target Devices.
offline.device_banner_body: Settings saved here are queued in Home Assistant and sync automatically when this Device wakes or reconnects. Live quick actions are unavailable while offline.
offline.ble_tx_off_body: Enable the BLE Transmitter sensor in the Home Assistant Companion App on this phone so Bluetooth proxies can detect its Area.
card.replace_hardware_body: Replaced a physical board or reflashed under a new ESPHome node? Use Reconfigure on this Device entry in Home Assistant Integrations to rebind its hardware identity while keeping all shortcuts, Area rules, and settings.
devices.empty_zero_body: Adopt discovered Latter displays, add Bluetooth tags for Area presence, or configure System Area sensor fusion.
discovered.empty_latter: No unconfigured Latter Devices found in Home Assistant. Newly added ESPHome Devices running Latter firmware appear here automatically.
discovered.paused_hint: List updates paused ({count} shown). Select Resume list to refresh.
discovered.empty_ble_filtered: No Bluetooth devices match this filter.
dev_overview.restart_device_desc: Reboots this Device; Wi-Fi and active sessions reconnect automatically.
dev_overview.empty_quick_actions: No live actions reported by this Device.
dev_overview.device_group_custom_desc: Uses individual operational settings; save as a reusable group or pick an existing preset.
dev_overview.device_group_preset_desc: Applies shared operational settings (power, wake word, brightness, BLE).
dev_overview.device_category_desc: Classifies this Bluetooth Device under Phones or BLE tags across Managed devices.
dev_overview.assigned_person_desc: Links this Device's Area presence to a Home Assistant person entity.
dev_overview.remote_group_desc: Controls which TV and AV remotes appear in the Remote app.
dev_overview.ringing_alert_text: An alarm or timer is ringing on this Device.
dev_overview.alarms_desc: Syncs 2-way with on-device alarm edits (1-minute precision).
dev_display.bedtime_brightness_override_: Bedtime mode is currently active and overriding screen brightness.
dev_display.screensaver_preview_desc: Starts the screensaver on this Device immediately.
dev_display.custom_color_desc: Used when Color profile is set to Custom.
dev_display.wallpapers_subtitle: Shared presets and uploaded photos cropped for this display.
dev_display.wp_weather_bg_note: Weather background is enabled on Home — wallpapers appear across other screens.
dev_display.wp_off: Off — select Use on a wallpaper below or enable rotation.
dev_display.wp_hint_none: No wallpapers starred — rotation cycles through all wallpapers.
dev_display.wp_hint_one: 1 wallpaper starred — star at least 2 to cycle between favorites.
dev_interface.enable_home_desc: Provides the Home screen and App Dock. Turn off to lock this Device to a single start screen app.
dev_interface.start_screen_multi_desc: Choose the screen shown on startup. Swipe up from the bottom to return to Home.
dev_interface.start_screen_single_desc: Single-app screen shown at all times while the Home screen is disabled.
dev_interface.time_format_desc: Applies 12-hour or 24-hour time across Home, alarms, calendar, and schedules.
dev_interface.home_clock_tap_desc: Choose whether tapping the clock readout on Home opens the Time app or the standalone clock face.
dev_interface.clock_face_desc: Visual style for the standalone clock face screen.
dev_interface.home_date_tap_desc: Choose whether tapping the date readout on Home opens Day view or Overview in the Calendar app.
dev_interface.return_timeout_desc: Resets idle screens back to Home unless media is playing or a live activity is active.
dev_interface.wake_greeting_desc: Shows a brief morning, afternoon, or evening greeting after waking from standby.
dev_interface.weather_bg_desc: Replaces the Home screen backdrop with a live sky matching current conditions.
dev_interface.sun_moon_desc: Choose which sky bodies appear on the live weather background.
dev_interface.activity_card_desc: Shows live timers, alarms, media queue, stopwatch, and next calendar event on Home.
dev_interface.activity_sources_desc: Choose and reorder which live items appear in the Activity card.
dev_interface.app_dock_desc: Toggle, drag to reorder, and configure apps on the App Dock, or add custom subpage and Home Assistant entity shortcuts. Pinned hides automatically when empty.
dev_interface.settings_locked_meta: Always shown last on the App Dock
dev_audio.vfm_desc: Updates this roaming Device's Home Assistant Area when BLE presence settles in a new Area, so Area-less voice commands target where you are.
dev_audio.vfm_delay_desc: How long a BLE-detected Area stays stable before moving the Device (3 to 60 seconds).
dev_audio.default_speaker_desc: Primary speaker controlled from Music and Home when this Device starts up.
dev_audio.ma_player_unmatched_desc: Automatic match did not find {entity} in Music Assistant. Choose this Device's player for library playback, queues, and lyrics.
dev_audio.ma_player_manual_desc: Linked manually ({entity} was not used). Clear to return to automatic matching.
dev_audio.area_handoff_desc: Transfers active Music Assistant playback when this Device moves to or selects another Area.
dev_power.card_bedtime_subtitle: Turns off or dims the display overnight and silences non-critical notification chimes.
dev_power.empty: No sleep or battery entities reported by this Device.
dev_presence.track_ble_desc: Uses Home Assistant Area-assigned Bluetooth proxies to locate this Device automatically. Turn off to pin it to one assigned Area.
dev_presence.auto_switch_desc: Switches the Device's active Area controls automatically when BLE detects a move.
dev_presence.fallback_area_desc: Default Home Assistant Area when no Bluetooth proxy is in range.
dev_presence.assigned_area_desc: Pins this Device's Area controls and Home Assistant Device Area to one location.
dev_presence.target_addr_help: Leave blank on Latter displays to track their built-in BLE beacon MAC automatically.
dev_presence.ref_power_help: Leave blank to use auto-detected beacon power in dBm, or enter -90 to -30 dBm to calibrate this Device.
dev_presence.companion_low_body: This phone is advertising at {txPower} power{modeSuffix}.{refSuffix} Setting Transmit Power to Medium or High and Advertise Mode to Balanced in the Home Assistant Companion App improves multi-Area accuracy through walls.
dev_presence.companion_ref_suffix: Latter automatically compensates its 1 m reference power ({dbm} dBm).
dev_tools.diagnostics_file_desc: Downloads redacted Home Assistant diagnostics for troubleshooting.
dev_tools.backup_row_desc: Downloads this Device's Latter configuration and settings as JSON.
dev_tools.perimeter_subtitle: Governs unlocking doors, disarming alarms, and opening garage or gate covers from this Device.
dev_tools.pin_policy_desc_prefix: Auto requires a PIN on stationary wall panels when configured and allows roaming personal Devices. Effective policy:
dev_tools.security_pin_desc: Write-only 4 to 12 digit numeric PIN verified by Home Assistant when the on-device keypad prompts. Never shown again after saving.
dev_tools.reset_defaults_desc: Resets on-device preferences and/or Latter settings while keeping Wi-Fi and Home Assistant pairing.
dev_tools.remove_device_desc: Removes this Device from Latter. Your ESPHome device stays in Home Assistant.
